name: World Bank Open Data
description: Query public World Bank economic, social, and development indicators, including GDP, population, inflation, employment, education, health, and environmental data. No API key is required and all operations are read-only.
whenToUse: Use it to query or compare country and regional development indicators, inspect indicator definitions and country metadata, or retrieve historical and latest available observations. It is not a real-time market data source, and statistical releases may lag the current date.

world_bank_countries.description: Query country and region codes, regions, income levels, capitals, and geographic metadata.

world_bank_catalog.description: Browse common indicators, topics, topic indicators, or the detailed definition of one indicator.

world_bank_data.description: Query World Bank observations by country, indicator, and year range; defaults to the latest available non-empty observation. Oversized pages keep structured metadata and a partial records array, with truncation fields and a hint to narrow the query.
